metadata.label: Shape model
metadata.coverage: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.

transfer.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy. Every bilinear contributor must be within 20 m of the closest RMOC source point; the same point must be visible in the full RMOC mesh.

metadata.label: OSIRIS mosaic
metadata.coverage: Four OSIRIS orange-filter observations, 5–6 August 2014. Grayscale with approximate illumination correction and bounded brightness matching; photographed shadows and some seams remain. Gray grid marks missing or rejected imagery. Shadows off shows the mosaic uniformly lit; Shadows on adds modeled lighting at the shared 3 September 2026 epoch. This is not an albedo map.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Horizons osculating elements; ESA/RMOC measured pole in the Cheops frame.
celestial.qualification: ESA/RMOC MTP019 measured nucleus shape, simplified for display. Neutral gray is a model material, not a photograph or an albedo map. The measured north pole is retained; rotational phase is arbitrary. Solar geometry uses the shared 3 September 2026 epoch.

panel.introduction: 67P/Churyumov–Gerasimenko is the two-lobed comet explored by Rosetta. Rotate its measured nucleus to inspect the narrow neck, steep cliffs and recessed terrain.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Nucleus shape measured by Rosetta and simplified for display. The gray surface is a model material.
controls.title: Nucleus shape reconstruction

controls.label: OSIRIS mosaic
controls.description: Rosetta photographs fitted to the nucleus. Their brightness has been adjusted, but the original shadows and some seams remain.
controls.title: OSIRIS image mosaic
controls.summary: Photographs cover parts of the nucleus. Brightness is adjusted to match images; original shadows and some seams remain.

controls.label: Albedo
controls.description: How strongly surface grains scatter green light. Higher values mean more scattering. Turn Shadows off to read the color scale.
controls.title: VIRTIS single-scattering albedo

controls.label: Spectral slope
controls.description: How much reflectance rises from green to red light. Higher values mean a redder spectrum. Turn Shadows off to read the color scale.
controls.title: VIRTIS visible spectral slope

controls.label: 3.2 µm absorption
controls.description: Strength of the broad 3.2 µm absorption band. This measurement alone cannot tell us how much organic material is present. Turn Shadows off to read the scale.
controls.title: VIRTIS 3.2 µm absorption depth

controls.label: Modeled ice
controls.description: Estimated ice seen in reflected light, not the ice stored inside the comet. A value of 0% means the model fitted no ice. Turn Shadows off to read the scale.
controls.title: VIRTIS surface ice fraction

sources.label: Modeled ice
sources.coverage: Water-ice optical cross-section fraction from an intimate-mixture model with dark terrain and fitted micrometer grains. Zero is valid. This is not bulk ice content; localized ice patches can violate the mixture model. VIRTIS MTP006 · Aug–Sep 2014. False color on the RMOC shape; angular registration is approximate. Gray grid marks missing, rejected or ambiguous coverage. Shadows off preserves the numeric colors; Shadows on adds modeled lighting at the shared 2026 epoch. Values beyond the displayed scale use its end colors.
